method: tool_score = 04_risk hindcast formula with that year's actual main-season rainfall anomaly (JJAS; OND for ond_scored_lgds) as the scenario; structural terms (sensitivity, capacity, price) as of today, no live NDVI; bands from kpis.json band_thresholds. yield_dev_pct = actual foodgrain yield vs trailing 10-year Theil-Sen trend. warned = band in (medium, high) and yield_dev_pct <= -5. lgbm_oos_shock_pct = leave-one-year-out LightGBM (04b). all_india_jjas_anom_pct = gross-cropped-area-weighted JJAS rainfall (mm) vs its 2000-2024 mean (same definition as 02_climate report); all-India yield_dev_pct weighted by that year's foodgrain production; oni_jja_son = mean ONI JJA..SON; phase = monsoon-year ENSO phase (mean ONI JJA..OND).
